messages:
incident-bot: automatic pager: NebulaApps (dedicated cluster nebula-ord1) — sustained elevated latency and errors detected. p50 ~ 3x baseline, p99 spiking, 5% 5xx over 3m. Affected route: /api/v1/chat. PagerDuty: INC-7890123. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-latency

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-7890123 fired and notified on-call. Escalation policy: default-reserved-capacity.

Samir (oncall): acked in PD, taking it. Jumping onto nebula-ord1 console now.

Priya G: thanks — are customers seeing timeouts or 5xx? any specific tenant impact besides NebulaApps?

Samir (oncall): NebulaApps is the only tenant on the reserved pool atm. They're reporting interactive timeouts and degraded throughput. Queue depth showing sustained growth on the reserved scheduler.

Elena R: checking kv-cache evictions and disk-backed swap. Running quick query:
```
kubectl -n reserved-ord1 logs -l app=serving-runtime --tail=200 | grep -i "evict\|oom\|slow_kv" | tail -n 50
# output: 2026-03-14T22:05:12Z WARN kv_cache: eviction triggered, size=1.2GB, evict_count=342
# 2026-03-14T22:06:01Z ERROR request: handler timeout, p99=2100ms
```

Samir (oncall): observed a pattern: small spike in prefix cache evictions right before p99 jumps. Also CPU on the head node hit 95% for a minute. Noticed recent rollout of batcher v3.2 yesterday — possible perf regression.

Priya G: good catch. Can we route NebulaApps to fallback variant (quantized small model) while we mitigate? That'll preserve availability.

Samir (oncall): doing traffic routing now. Using the console quick action: route tenant nebulaapps -> model: gpt-small-q4f.

incident-bot: action logged: tenant routing change applied by Samir (oncall). Old route -> new route.

Samir (oncall): scaled reserved pool nebula-reserved-ord1 +2 GPUs (hot scale). Applied immediate autoscale override for 15m.

pagerduty-bot: INC-7890123 escalated to Level 2 (SRE) due to >5% 5xx. Notified: Elena R, Morgan S.

Elena R: joining bridge. quick checks: no obvious disk pressure, but batcher v3.2 shows a locking stall on request coalescing in logs. suspect batching change introduced contention.

Samir (oncall): after routing + scale, p50 dropping back toward baseline, p99 improving but still noisy. Errors down to ~1.2%. NebulaApps confirms fewer timeouts.

NebulaApps Support Bot: customer notif sent: "We're investigating elevated latency on your dedicated cluster. We've applied a temporary routing change and scaled capacity to reduce impact. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary."

Priya G: excellent. I'll document mitigation steps in the incident ticket and start a canned customer update for NebulaApps execs.

Samir (oncall): quick mitigation actions summary: 1) routed tenant to fallback model variant 2) hot-scaled reserved pool +2 GPUs 3) rolled back batcher v3.2 to v3.1 on one canary to validate. Early signs look good.

Elena R: rolling back batcher globally requires change freeze approval; for now we revert canary to see effect. If p99 normalizes, we'll plan a full rollback with SRE and release owners.

pagerduty-bot: INC-7890123 acknowledged by Samir (oncall) at 2026-03-14T22:07:30Z, escalated at 2026-03-14T22:12:05Z.

Priya G: FYI I'll be off in 40m. If errors jump back above 3% or p99 > 2s, escalate to next PD rotation and call the on-call SRE.

Samir (oncall): noted. Setting alert suppression for noisy metric flapping for 10m while we stabilize.

Elena R: after reverting canary batcher -> v3.1, canary p99 dropped from 2.2s -> 0.8s within 3m. Strong signal batcher v3.2 regression.

Samir (oncall): promoting rollback to full reserved pool. Applying rolling restart with v3.1 now (controlled, 1 node at a time).

incident-bot: runbook checkpoint: "reserved-latency" — follow step: escalate to SRE and consider rollback of recent batcher release. Completed by Elena R.

Samir (oncall): final status at 22:45 UTC: p50/p99 back to baseline, 5xx <0.5%. NebulaApps reports restored service. Lifting hot scale and removing autoscale override.

NebulaApps Support Bot: customer notif sent: "Service restored. We're performing root cause analysis and will provide an RCA."

Priya G: nice work team. Action items: - postmortem + RCA (Elena) - add kv_cache and batcher_release dimensions to the reserved-latency alert (Samir) - update runbook with explicit rollback play for batcher releases (Priya)

Samir (oncall): handing off to Elena for post-incident follow-up. I'm stepping off the incident channel.

Elena R: taking handoff. I'll open INC-7890123 with RCA draft and link to logs and diff of v3.2 changes.

incident-bot: incident closed by Elena R at 2026-03-14T23:02:15Z. Postmortem assigned.

Priya G: adding final note — customers that have pinned model variants should be surveyed; add a guardrail in the deploy pipeline to require perf signoff for batcher changes. :white_check_mark:

Samir (oncall): thanks all, marking as resolved on my side. :thumbsup:
